task: pairwise Evidence x specific Claim Revision relation classification
notes: Dataset authored after the v0.2C protocol freeze and before any R2 evaluation.
Evidence statements are concise paraphrases or arithmetic summaries of cited primary SEC filing facts.
R1/R2 repair results and the prior v0.2B holdout were not used to select or relabel individual v0.2C cases.
This dataset is a single-review engineering holdout, not publication-grade gold.

locators: Subscription and Support Revenues by Service Offering

claim.statement: Costco net sales increased from fiscal 2024 to fiscal 2025.

evidence.statement: Costco net sales were 249625 million USD in 2024 and 269912 million USD in 2025.

annotation.basis: 2025 net sales exceed 2024 net sales.

claim.statement: Costco gross margin percentage increased from fiscal 2024 to fiscal 2025.

evidence.statement: Costco gross margin percentage was 10.92 percent in 2024 and 11.12 percent in 2025.

annotation.basis: Gross margin percentage rose by 20 basis points.

claim.statement: Costco membership fee revenue increased in fiscal 2025.

evidence.statement: Costco United States operating income was 6217 million USD in 2024 and 6878 million USD in 2025.

annotation.basis: United States operating income does not directionally establish membership fee revenue.

claim.statement: Costco total-company comparable sales growth accelerated in fiscal 2025 compared with fiscal 2024.

evidence.statement: Costco total-company comparable sales growth was 5 percent in 2024 and 6 percent in 2025.

annotation.basis: Comparable-sales growth increased from 5% to 6%.

claim.statement: Higher comparable sales were a primary driver of Costco's net sales increase in fiscal 2025.

evidence.statement: Costco net sales increased 20287 million USD or 8 percent in 2025, and the filing says the improvement was primarily attributable to a 14788 million USD or 6 percent increase in comparable sales.

annotation.basis: The filing explicitly attributes most of the net-sales improvement to comparable sales.

claim.statement: Costco Canada operating income increased from fiscal 2024 to fiscal 2025.

evidence.statement: Costco Other International operating income was 1420 million USD in 2024 and 1656 million USD in 2025.

annotation.basis: The metric matches but the segment scope is Other International, not Canada.

claim.statement: Costco membership fee revenue growth accelerated in fiscal 2025.

evidence.statement: Costco membership fee revenue was 4828 million USD in 2024 and 5323 million USD in 2025.

annotation.basis: The pair establishes 2025 growth but provides no prior comparable growth rate for acceleration.

claim.statement: Fresh foods were the sole cause of Costco's gross margin percentage improvement in fiscal 2025.

evidence.statement: Costco gross margin percentage increased 20 basis points; core merchandise contributed positively, primarily due to fresh foods and the co-branded credit card program, while other factors including a LIFO charge were negative.

annotation.basis: The filing identifies multiple positive and negative contributors, so fresh foods were not the sole cause.

claim.statement: JPMorgan Chase total net revenue increased from 2024 to 2025.

evidence.statement: JPMorgan Chase total net revenue was 177556 million USD in 2024 and 182447 million USD in 2025.

annotation.basis: 2025 total net revenue exceeds 2024.

claim.statement: JPMorgan Chase net income increased in 2025.

evidence.statement: JPMorgan Chase reported net income of 57.0 billion USD for 2025, down 2 percent from 2024.

annotation.basis: The filing explicitly reports a 2% decline in net income.

claim.statement: JPMorgan Chase net interest income increased in 2025.

evidence.statement: Firmwide Wealth Management client assets were 3756 billion USD in 2024 and 4521 billion USD in 2025.

annotation.basis: Client assets do not directionally establish firmwide net interest income.

claim.statement: Asset & Wealth Management net revenue growth accelerated in 2025 compared with 2024.

evidence.statement: Asset & Wealth Management net revenue was 19827 million USD in 2023, 21578 million USD in 2024 and 24073 million USD in 2025, corresponding to roughly 9 percent growth in 2024 and 12 percent growth in 2025.

annotation.basis: The annual growth rate increased from about 9% to about 12%.

claim.statement: Higher Markets net interest income contributed to JPMorgan Chase's firmwide net interest income growth in 2025.

evidence.statement: Firmwide net interest income was 95.4 billion USD, up 3 percent in 2025, driven in part by higher Markets net interest income, alongside higher revolving balances, wholesale deposit balances and investment-securities activity.

annotation.basis: The filing explicitly lists higher Markets net interest income as a driver.

claim.statement: Consumer & Community Banking net income increased from 2024 to 2025.

evidence.statement: Commercial & Investment Bank net income was 24846 million USD in 2024 and 27761 million USD in 2025.

annotation.basis: The metric matches but the business segment is Commercial & Investment Bank, not Consumer & Community Banking.

claim.statement: JPMorgan Chase net interest income growth accelerated in 2025.

evidence.statement: JPMorgan Chase net interest income was 95.4 billion USD in 2025, up 3 percent from 2024.

annotation.basis: A single annual growth rate does not establish acceleration.

claim.statement: JPMorgan Chase net income increased in 2025 because total net revenue increased.

evidence.statement: JPMorgan Chase total net revenue increased 3 percent in 2025, while net income declined 2 percent to 57.0 billion USD.

annotation.basis: The claimed outcome is directly contradicted: net income declined despite higher revenue.

claim.statement: Salesforce total revenue increased from fiscal 2025 to fiscal 2026.

evidence.statement: Salesforce total revenue was 37895 million USD in fiscal 2025 and 41525 million USD in fiscal 2026.

annotation.basis: Fiscal 2026 revenue exceeds fiscal 2025 revenue.

claim.statement: Salesforce operating margin increased from fiscal 2025 to fiscal 2026.

evidence.statement: Salesforce operating margin was approximately 19 percent in fiscal 2025 and approximately 20 percent in fiscal 2026.

annotation.basis: Operating margin increased by about one percentage point.

claim.statement: Salesforce remaining performance obligation increased by January 31, 2026.

evidence.statement: Salesforce cash, cash equivalents and marketable securities were 14032 million USD at January 31, 2025 and 9565 million USD at January 31, 2026.

annotation.basis: Cash and marketable securities do not directionally establish remaining performance obligation.

claim.statement: Salesforce total revenue growth accelerated in fiscal 2026 compared with fiscal 2025.

evidence.statement: Salesforce total revenue was 34857 million USD in fiscal 2024, 37895 million USD in fiscal 2025 and 41525 million USD in fiscal 2026, corresponding to roughly 9 percent growth in fiscal 2025 and 10 percent growth in fiscal 2026.

annotation.basis: The annual growth rate increased from roughly 9% to roughly 10%.

claim.statement: Volume-driven new business was the primary cause of Salesforce subscription and support revenue growth in fiscal 2026.

evidence.statement: Salesforce says the increase in subscription and support revenue in fiscal 2026 was primarily caused by volume-driven increases from new business, including new customers, upgrades and additional subscriptions from existing customers.

annotation.basis: The filing explicitly identifies volume-driven new business as the primary cause.

claim.statement: Salesforce Europe revenue increased in fiscal 2026.

evidence.statement: Salesforce Americas revenue was 25143 million USD in fiscal 2025 and 27193 million USD in fiscal 2026.

annotation.basis: The metric matches but the geography is Americas, not Europe.

claim.statement: Salesforce remaining performance obligation growth accelerated by January 31, 2026.

evidence.statement: Salesforce remaining performance obligation was 63.4 billion USD at January 31, 2025 and 72.4 billion USD at January 31, 2026, an increase of about 14 percent.

annotation.basis: The pair provides only the latest growth interval, not a prior comparable growth rate.

claim.statement: Pricing was a significant driver of Salesforce subscription and support revenue growth in fiscal 2026.

evidence.statement: Salesforce says subscription and support revenue growth was primarily caused by volume-driven new business and that pricing was not a significant driver of the increase.

annotation.basis: The filing explicitly states that pricing was not a significant driver.

claim.statement: Caterpillar total sales and revenues increased from 2024 to 2025.

evidence.statement: Caterpillar total sales and revenues were 64809 million USD in 2024 and 67589 million USD in 2025.

annotation.basis: 2025 total sales and revenues exceed 2024.

claim.statement: Caterpillar operating profit margin increased in 2025.

evidence.statement: Caterpillar operating profit margin was 20.2 percent in 2024 and 16.5 percent in 2025.

annotation.basis: Operating profit margin decreased by 3.7 percentage points.

claim.statement: Caterpillar profit per share increased in 2025.

evidence.statement: Caterpillar total sales and revenues increased 4 percent in 2025 to 67.589 billion USD.

annotation.basis: Sales growth does not directionally establish profit per share.

claim.statement: Caterpillar total sales and revenue growth accelerated in 2025 compared with 2024.

evidence.statement: Caterpillar total sales and revenues were 67060 million USD in 2023, 64809 million USD in 2024 and 67589 million USD in 2025, corresponding to about negative 3 percent growth in 2024 and positive 4 percent growth in 2025.

annotation.basis: Growth improved from a decline in 2024 to positive growth in 2025.

claim.statement: Higher sales volume was a primary driver of Caterpillar's increase in total sales and revenues in 2025.

evidence.statement: Caterpillar says the 2025 increase in total sales and revenues reflected higher sales volume, partially offset by unfavorable price realization; higher sales volume was primarily driven by higher equipment sales to end users.

annotation.basis: The filing directly attributes the increase to higher sales volume, with price realization as an offset.

claim.statement: Caterpillar Construction Industries sales increased in 2025.

evidence.statement: Caterpillar reports that sales were higher in Power & Energy in 2025.

annotation.basis: The sales direction is for Power & Energy, not Construction Industries.

claim.statement: Caterpillar operating profit margin compression intensified in 2025.

evidence.statement: Caterpillar operating profit margin decreased from 20.2 percent in 2024 to 16.5 percent in 2025.

annotation.basis: The pair establishes compression in 2025 but not whether the compression intensified versus a prior change.

claim.statement: Higher sales volume fully offset manufacturing-cost and price-realization pressure, causing Caterpillar operating profit to increase in 2025.

evidence.statement: Caterpillar operating profit decreased 15 percent in 2025, primarily due to unfavorable manufacturing costs and unfavorable price realization, partially offset by the profit impact of higher sales volume.

annotation.basis: The filing reports that higher sales volume only partially offset the pressures and operating profit decreased.
